entries.20222780d5e71f47: An insurance holding company that has Sompo Japan and others under its umbrella and handles non-life insurance and life insurance in Japan and overseas, as well as nursing care businesses.
entries.24026fe180b30aa6: This is a business not included in the reportable segments, and it covers the company, which is an insurance holding company, the digital-related business, the asset management business and others. As of March 31, 2026, SOMPO Light Vortex Co., Ltd. (digital-related business), SOMPO Asset Management Co., Ltd. (asset management business), Sompo Japan DC Securities Co., Ltd. (defined contribution pension business) and SOMPO Health Support Co., Ltd. (healthcare business) are consolidated subsidiaries with a voting rights ownership ratio of 100.0% (including indirect ownership), and its equity-method affiliates include Palantir Technologies Japan Co., Ltd. (software sales business; voting rights ownership ratio of 50.0%). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥41,989 million, and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥1,319 million. The number of employees was 6,995 as of March 31, 2026, and all 489 employees of the company, which is the filing company, belong to this category.
entries.269c34d124646889: This business is one in which SOMPO Himawari Life Insurance Co., Ltd. underwrites life insurance and carries out asset management in Japan. Together with the nursing care business, it falls within the “SOMPO Well-being” area. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥258,707 million, the 3rd largest among the reportable segments. By breakdown of insurance revenue, individual insurance was ¥247,722 million, group insurance was ¥9,875 million and individual annuity insurance was ¥1,109 million. Insurance revenue rose 1.6% year on year, and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥68,605 million (¥29,876 million in the previous fiscal year). The company explains that insurance revenue increased due to growth in in-force contracts, centered on protection-type products and variable insurance, and that profit improved due to better asset management gains and losses from the weaker yen and rising interest rates. It also launched a new type of variable insurance and worked on sales that propose insurance and health support as one package. The number of employees was 2,770 as of March 31, 2026.
entries.26a07209680e95f7: This business is one in which SOMPO Himawari Life Insurance Co., Ltd. underwrites life insurance and carries out asset management in Japan.
entries.2b562205e002b708: It consists of the "Operator Business," in which SOMPO Care Inc. provides services from home care to facility care; the "Solutions Business," which sells care food services externally and sells consulting and human resource development programs for care facilities externally; and a business in which N.D. Software Co., Ltd. provides systems for care settings, among others. Its revenue is recorded not as insurance revenue but as "other operating revenue," and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥186,207 million, the 4th among the reportable segments. Other operating revenue increased 2.7% from the previous year, and profit for the year attributable to owners of the parent was ¥7,951 million (¥5,303 million in the previous year). The company explains that revenue increased owing to an increase in the number of users and the effect of price revisions, and that although personnel costs rose in line with improved treatment of staff, the increase in sales outweighed it. The number of employees is 13,511 (as of March 31, 2026), the largest among the 5 categories after the Domestic Non-Life Insurance Business.
entries.36d7835a3285d25b: This business underwrites insurance and carries out asset management overseas, centered on Sompo International Holdings Ltd. (Bermuda). Its subsidiaries include Endurance Specialty Insurance Ltd., Endurance Assurance Corporation (U.S.), Endurance Worldwide Insurance Limited (U.K.), Sompo Holdings (Asia) Pte. Ltd. (Singapore), Sompo Sigorta Anonim Sirketi (Turkey), Sompo Seguros S.A. (Brazil) and others. In February 2026, it acquired all shares of Aspen Insurance Holdings Limited, which has a presence in major insurance markets such as Lloyd's, the U.K., the U.S. and reinsurance, and made it a consolidated subsidiary. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,428,717 million, the 2nd largest among the reportable segments. Insurance revenue (including internal transactions) was ¥2,441,152 million, up 9.6% year on year, and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥294,489 million (¥177,771 million in the previous fiscal year). The company explains that the increase in revenue at Sompo International Holdings Ltd. was the main driver of the rise in insurance revenue, and that a decrease in natural disasters and higher interest and dividend income from growth in invested assets pushed up profit. It also pursued initiatives including strengthening the mid-market business in North America, expanding products and services in Europe, and delegating underwriting authority in Asia Pacific. The number of employees was 8,991 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.c2d075cc4513a4b7: Sompo Japan Insurance Inc. and SOMPO Direct Non-Life Insurance Co., Ltd. underwrite non-life insurance and carry out asset management, among other activities, in Japan through this business. Together with the overseas insurance business, it is operated as one unit under the name “SOMPO P&C (Non-Life Insurance Business).” Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,685,496 million, the largest among the 4 reportable segments and other categories. Insurance revenue (including internal transactions between segments) was ¥2,730,572 million, up 3.6% year on year, and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥268,112 million (¥58,338 million in the previous fiscal year). The company explains that insurance revenue increased due to the effects of pricing optimization for automobile and fire insurance and the expansion of sales of new-type insurance, and that profit increased due to a decrease in natural disasters and an increase in investment gains and losses. Sompo Japan Insurance Inc. is advancing the transformation of its business and earnings foundations through the company-wide project “SJ-R.” The number of employees was 23,435 as of March 31, 2026.
